root: ^Today I met a doctor, who was late for his own solution. He said that the time wasn’t the one who let him down.
^I have always kept my papers in order.
^Why do you refuse to cross over?
^Your ticket is valid. You have the right to continue (stamp the ticket)

c-0: ^Why do you refuse to cross over?
c-1: ^Your ticket is valid. You have the right to continue

a_right_to_continue: ^You do not yet grasp the gravity of your mistake.
^I reported him. He broke the rules. He should have known better. He wanted to fix the world. And I wanted to keep everything in order.
unfinished_matters: ^At first, a handful of cases. Then entire households.
^I believed I was protecting the world…
^Yet I condemned the town to death.
^I am sorry, but there is nothing more you can do now. Your time has come (stamp the ticket)

c-1: ^I am sorry, but there is nothing more you can do now. Your time has come

my_time_has_come: ^Still, I hoped I might atone for my mistake.
^I reported him. He broke the rules. He should have known better. He wanted to fix the world. And I wanted to keep everything in order.
hopelessness: ^Every remedy. Every mixture, every method recorded in old tomes.
^Nothing worked. People died before my eyes, faster each day.
^So this is how your story ends?
^When I was certain the end had come… I looked upon my notes
^The proportions… if only they had been altared…
^Why do you wish to remain on this train?
^I am sorry to hear this, but I must let you pass. These are the rules. (stamp the ticket)

c-0: ^Why do you wish to remain on this train?
c-1: ^I am sorry to hear this, but I must let you pass. These are the rules.

the_rules: ^I reported him. He broke the rules. He should have known better. He wanted to fix the world. And I wanted to keep everything in order.
a_purpose: ^And I still wish to make amends.
^If I cross over, that chance is lost forever.
^This train… it remembers, does it not?
^…This train will wait for you a little longer.
^You have already surrendered. One lives but once. And you have made your choice. (stamp the ticket)

c-1: ^You have already surrendered. One lives but once. And you have made your choice.

rest_in_peace: ^I always knew that not every mistake can be undone.
^Yet every choice remains with us forever…
^But never forget. It, too, can be wrong.
^I reported him. He broke the rules. He should have known better. He wanted to fix the world. And I wanted to keep everything in order.
train_will_wait: ^I broke the rules. I should have reported this incident. But I didn't. Why? Was it for him? Because I pity him? Or was it because I hoped that him breaking the rules would bring peace to others who are still alive?
^The Ghost didn’t reached the designated destination, despite having a valid ticket
^Then perhaps someone else will not repeat my mistake.
